_note: The plain-template fallback for /explain (MASTERSPEC 7.5). English only; same placeholders and neutral tone as the AI text. {design} is the design's name. A sentence is used only when every placeholder in it is in the numbers map.

opening.fits: The {design} may fit on this lot: every rule we checked passes with room to spare.
opening.borderline: The {design} is too close to call on this lot.
opening.no_fit: The {design} doesn't fit on this lot.
opening.not_checked: Suplex did not check the {design} on this lot.

rule.lot_width: It needs {{lot_width_required}} m of lot width, and this lot measures about {{lot_width_actual}} m.
rule.lot_depth: It needs {{lot_depth_required}} m of lot depth, and this lot measures about {{lot_depth_actual}} m.
rule.building_length: The design is {{building_length_design}} m long, and {{building_length_allowed}} m is allowed on this lot.
rule.height: The design is {{height_design}} m tall, and {{height_allowed}} m is allowed on this lot.
rule.lot_coverage: It would cover {{coverage_actual_pct}}% of the lot, and {{coverage_allowed_pct}}% is allowed.
rule.units_allowed: The design has {{units_design}} homes, and {{units_allowed}} are allowed on this lot.
rule.detached_building: The City's free designs are detached buildings, and the house on this lot is attached.

band.m: That difference is inside our {{uncertainty_band_m}} m uncertainty band, because the City's lot lines are not survey-accurate.
band.pct: That difference is inside our {{uncertainty_band_coverage_pp}} percentage point uncertainty band, because the City's lot lines are not survey-accurate.

screening: This is a screening, not a permit.
next_step: A designer or the City's zoning examiner can confirm.
next_step_borderline: A survey and the City's zoning examiner can confirm.
